fact: 贝利森特夫人说第一领主 Phelan 是她姐妹的儿子（她的外甥），她必须回儿子在 Abaingeat 的宅子。
anchor: My sister’s son, First Lord Phelan, has a decision to make.

fact: 她怀疑那个深肤色女孩 Vedra 参与失窃：小无赖曾被看见出现在失物所在的高塔附近。
anchor: the little wretch had been seen near the tower where the . . . thing was stolen

fact: 她先前另找的占卜师都不顶用：一个农家女孩尖叫倒地不省人事，更早的一个死了。
anchor: One peasant girl, a little brown thing, shrieked and fell down, insensible

fact: Vespillis 说那面妖精镜的价值远超同等重量的黄金，他花了半辈子破解它的秘密。
anchor: It is worth greatly more than its weight in gold

fact: 占卜时他仰头翻眼只见眼白，蜡烛乱舞、帷幔鼓荡，最后镜子从手中落到地毯上。
anchor: His head fell back and his eyes rolled up until only the whites were showing

fact: 他报称看见海中立着一块怪石，名叫 Goblin Rock，位于港口城镇 Crannhyr 的湾口。
anchor: It is called Goblin Rock, and it stands at the mouth of the port town of Crannhyr

fact: 夫人让他去 Phelan 的管家那里领赏，他却推说身体不适、改日再来支取。
anchor: Go to Phelan’s steward and he will see you get your payment
